about: great Abyssinia P.L.C. has its roots back to the early nineties when it was established as a sole proprietorship with an initial capital of Birr 10,000 with 10 emmployees by roasting, grounding and packing Arabica coffee using an old & dilapidated machine for exclusive domestic market consumption. In 2003 The enterprise has been reorganized as a private limited company with a capital of Birr 4.5 million fully subscribed in and also renamed as Great Abyssinia P.L.C.
